headline: Product Manager | Clinician-Facing Software | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years in health software at Greenway Health. I was clinical lead on a new AI-first EHR, wrote PRDs from recurring client pain points that product teams built, and trained 200+ providers and staff on new workflows, so I know how clinics really work and how permissions and roles show up in their day. I also founded Roovero, an AI SaaS product I own from requirements through build and iteration with paying pilot clients.
greenway_bullets: Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas and user goals, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Wrote PRDs and feature requests from recurring client friction, and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees and the Clinical Content Team.
Owned implementations for close to 200 client practices and trained 200+ providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants on new workflows.
Presented product concepts to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference (50 attendees).
skills: requirements, user stories, prioritisation, prototyping, release coordination, launch readiness, stakeholder alignment
patient safety triage, stage-gate release, clinical content, clinical workflows
React, GitHub, n8n, AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini)
thesis_html: Software that fits how clinics actually work. I have lived on both sides of it.
why_fit: I know who does what in a clinic, which is what roles and access have to reflect.
Recurring client pain points became features product teams built.
Owns a product end to end
